name: FiveStar Product Image Gallery Control for WooCommerce
author: fivestarcreative

sections.description:
FiveStar Product Image Gallery Control for WooCommerce provides a clean admin settings dashboard to independently toggle on or off the native product gallery behaviors introduced in WooCommerce 3.0+.

By disabling these features via standard WordPress configuration hooks, you prevent heavy JavaScript libraries (such as Flexslider, PhotoSwipe, and Zoom.js) from loading on your frontend product pages, which can noticeably improve page speed and layout stability.

Key Features:

  • Toggle Image Zoom: Completely disable or enable the default hover zoom/magnifier layout.
  • Toggle Image Lightbox: Turn off the full-screen popup modal when clicking product photos.
  • Toggle Image Slider: Disable the product thumbnail carousel (useful if you prefer a stacked/grid display).
  • Lightweight Codebase: Built securely in a single file without unnecessary tracking or asset bloat.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fivestar-product-image-gallery-control-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Products and scroll down to the Product Gallery Settings section to configure your preferences.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin delete any of my images?

No. This plugin only changes how the product photos behave interactively on the frontend. Your raw media files remain completely untouched.

Will this override my premium theme?

The plugin hooks into theme setup configurations at a very late priority (100) to ensure your backend setting selections override any default configurations forced by popular ecommerce themes.

What happens if I disable the slider?

If you turn off the product image slider, product gallery thumbnails will gracefully fall back to a traditional grid layout stacked underneath or beside the primary product image (depending on your theme’s default WooCommerce CSS styling).
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial production release.
  • Added native settings section under WooCommerce > Settings > Products.
  • Implemented discrete hooks to remove ‘wc-product-gallery-zoom’, ‘wc-product-gallery-lightbox’, and ‘wc-product-gallery-slider’.
